context: A Kansai friend rants about a game with his girlfriend
purpose: Teach: ケータイ/オタク/あらかじめ/あきらめ/ものすごく/ビックリ/とりわけ/ひたすら

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 聞いてや、昨日彼女とゲームしててんけど、ものすごくキレてもうてん。
lines.en: Listen, I was playing a game with my girlfriend yesterday and I got incredibly pissed off.
lines.style: Kansai male venting to a friend with frustrated, fast-paced energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、ビックリした。何があったの?ケンカしちゃったの?
lines.en: Huh, you startled me. What happened? Did you two fight?
lines.style: Soft feminine voice expressing gentle surprise and concern.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 彼女な、対戦ゲームの前にあらかじめ作戦決めとこ言うたのに、ひたすら好き勝手動きよんねん。
lines.en: So she, even though I said let's decide a strategy beforehand for the versus game, she just kept doing whatever she wanted.
lines.style: Animated Kansai complaint, rapid-fire and exasperated tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、ダイちゃんって本当にゲームオタクだよね。彼女もきっと楽しみたかっただけだよ。
lines.en: Hehe, Dai-chan you really are a gaming nerd. She probably just wanted to have fun too.
lines.style: Teasing affectionate tone with a warm laughing lilt.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: いや、とりわけ腹立ったんが、負けた瞬間ケータイいじり始めてさ、聞いてへんねん。
lines.en: No, what especially pissed me off was the moment we lost she started messing with her phone and wasn't even listening.
lines.style: Heated Kansai grumbling with sharp emphatic gestures.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あー、それはちょっと寂しいね。でも喧嘩したくないなら、あきらめて流すのも大事だよ?
lines.en: Ah, that's a little lonely huh. But if you don't want to fight, sometimes letting it go and dropping it is important too, you know?
lines.style: Gentle nurturing advice with a soothing soft-spoken delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: わかってんねんけどなあ、好きやからこそ言いたいねん。まあ、今夜謝るわ。
lines.en: I get it, I really do, but it's because I love her that I want to say something. Well, I'll apologize tonight.
lines.style: Softer Kansai delivery shifting from frustration to reluctant tenderness.
